---
name: critique-track
description: "Critique tracks and mixes against references."
---

Measure with Voyager's audio engine when `<voyager_environment>` lists it as ready; the commands below are subcommands of the CLI it names. If it is not ready, say the critique needs it. You cannot hear: report what the measurements show, never a verdict on taste.

Ask for a bounce (WAV, AIFF, FLAC or MP3) and 2–4 current reference tracks it should sit with, unless given. Without references, a genre profile (`--profile NAME`; `library reference profile list`) is a rough starting point: say so.

```sh
analyze compare references BOUNCE.wav --reference REF.wav --reference REF2.wav
analyze compare references BOUNCE.wav --reference REFS_DIR --range drop
```

Changes in the user's Ableton set, when they ask: `edit-in-ableton`. After they change the track, compare the bounces: `analyze compare diff --previous OLD.wav NEW.wav`.
